CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.order_no IS NOT NULL AND o.order_no<>'' THEN CASE o.order_type WHEN '0' THEN 2 WHEN '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END ) x WHERE x.customer_order_rank=1 GROUP BY CAST(x.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(x.contract_no AS BINARY) ORDER BY CAST(x.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(x.contract_no AS BINARY) ) o LEFT JOIN (SELECT
